Press the keys 1, 2 and 3 to build a combo, then ⚔ to unleash it. Combat moves on in ticks of 1 second, and each combo acts over several ticks. Below a certain health, bosses turn to defence: they shield and heal themselves every second, and some rivals heal when their health runs low; stunning them cuts their healing short.
Chains: cast the combos of one family in order, from tier 1 to tier 4, and each link adds a bonus. Repeating the same tier or switching family breaks the chain; repeating tier 4 keeps the bonus.
Daze: each Stun raises the chance of dazing the rival, and a dazed rival is locked out for 10 s.
Only one multiplier and one shield can be active at a time.

Warden-Gambits is a native Android game written in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, with no graphics engine: here the logic rules. Beneath the cards beats a pure, deterministic combo-combat engine, tuned with a simulator that plays thousands of adventures to balance the numbers.

The story is written as data (24 zones and 507 nodes on the road to Mordor), the map is generated by code, the sounds are synthesised and the pixel-art images were made with Gemini from the author’s own prompts. It was all built with AI assistance (Claude Code), following a workflow of specs, plans, tests and reviews.

Oscar Martínez Gómez is a programmer, a lover of Tolkien’s world and a retired player of The Lord of the Rings Online (LOTRO). There, playing the Warden and its gambits, combos chained blow by blow, the idea for this game was born.
The game’s source code is public: you can read it, learn from it or suggest improvements on GitHub.
Fonts: Cinzel, Uncial Antiqua, Almendra and Alcarin Tengwar, under the SIL Open Font License (OFL).
Music: “Medieval: The Bard\'s Tale”, “Medieval: The Old Tower Inn” and “Medieval: King\'s Feast”, by RandomMind (OpenGameArt.org), under the CC0 1.0 licence (public domain).

Narration: voice synthesised with Kokoro-82M (hexgrad), a model under the Apache 2.0 licence, with the voices Dora (Spanish) and Heart (English). The sound effects were generated by code for this game.
Warden-Gambits is a fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders of J. R. R. Tolkien’s works or of The Lord of the Rings Online.

A combo is a sequence of keys: 1 is the spear, 2 the shield and 3 the fist. Tap them in order and press ⚔ to cast it. Every combo costs power, which slowly comes back on its own. The fight moves in one-second ticks: the combo resolves on the next tick and many of its effects last several ticks. Cast the tiers of one family in order (I, II, III, IV) to chain them and earn a bonus; switching family or repeating a tier breaks the chain, except tier IV, which you can repeat and keep the bonus.
Fury: tap 1 1 and cast ⚔. For 30 ticks your spear deals 20% more damage. It is a multiplier: it is not part of any chain (and casting it in the middle of one breaks it).
Spear I: tap 1 2. It wounds the rival every tick for 10 ticks. It is tier I: it opens the spear chain.
Spear II: tap 1 2 1 right after Spear I. Tier II deals double damage per tick; chained, it lasts 5 more ticks.
Spear III: tap 1 2 1 2. Tier III deals triple damage per tick; chained, it lasts 10 more ticks.
Spear IV: tap 1 2 1 2 1. The highest tier deals four times the damage per tick; chained, it lasts 20 more ticks. Chain complete!
This dummy hits back. Learn to protect and heal yourself while it attacks you.
Master Shield: tap 2 1 3 2 and cast ⚔. For 60 ticks you take 50% less damage.
Guard: tap 2 2. For 30 ticks you take 20% less damage. Together with the shield you will hold out much longer.
Heal I: tap 2 1. It heals you every tick for 10 ticks. It opens the heal chain.
Heal II: tap 2 1 2 right after Heal I. Tier II heals double per tick; chained, it lasts 5 more ticks.
Heal III: tap 2 1 2 1. Tier III heals triple per tick; chained, it lasts 10 more ticks.
Heal IV: tap 2 1 2 1 2. Tier IV heals four times per tick; chained, it lasts 20 more ticks. Remember: cast another combo in between and the chain breaks, back to tier I.
A Dazed fighter cannot act: if you are Dazed, your keys go dark until it wears off. This dummy will try to Daze you; you will learn to prevent it and to Daze the dummy instead.
Tactical Shield: tap 2 1 3 1 and cast ⚔. For 60 ticks you are immune to Daze: the dummy cannot stun you.
Vigour: tap 3 3. For 30 ticks your power regenerates 20% faster. Handy for paying for the chain that comes next.
Stun I: tap 3 1. It leaves the AT badge on the rival: a 5% chance of being Dazed, for 10 ticks. If the roll succeeds, the DZ star appears on its card and spins while it lasts: the rival cannot act.
Stun II: tap 3 1 3 right after. It chains and adds another 5% chance to the previous one.
Stun III: tap 3 1 3 1. Chained, it adds a 5% chance plus a 5% bonus.
Stun IV: tap 3 1 3 1 3. With the full chain it adds 5% plus a 30% bonus: now you are very likely to see the DZ star over the dummy.
Against several rivals, life drain takes health from all of them at once and gives it to you.
Guard: tap 2 2 and cast ⚔. There are three dummies: taking 20% less damage for 30 ticks helps you withstand their blows.
Life Drain I: tap 3 1 2 3. For 30 ticks, every 5 ticks it steals from each rival as much health as your heal restores and adds it to yours.
Life Drain II: tap 3 1 2 3 2 right after Life Drain I. It chains and multiplies the health you steal.
To finish a rival off, ready your spear, land a direct strike and end with a long Cross Spear chain.
Fury: tap 1 1 and cast ⚔. 20% more spear damage for 30 ticks: your finisher will hit harder.
Direct Strike: tap 1 2 3. It deals ten times your spear damage at once, without waiting for ticks. It costs 30 power and does not chain.
Cross Spear I: tap 1 3. Like the spear, it wounds every tick for 10 ticks, and it opens its own chain.
Cross Spear II: tap 1 3 1 right after. Tier II deals double damage per tick; chained, it lasts 5 more ticks.
Cross Spear III: tap 1 3 1 3. Tier III deals triple damage per tick; chained, it lasts 10 more ticks.
Cross Spear IV: tap 1 3 1 3 1. Tier IV deals four times the damage per tick; chained, it lasts 20 more ticks. Now you know how to finish a fight!
